samples.prompt: Some people support the proposal that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier. Others believe practical difficulties should be addressed before it is introduced widely. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are different views about the proposal that neighbourhoods should make household waste sorting easier. Supporters emphasise its usefulness, while others believe that practical difficulties should be dealt with before it is introduced more widely. Both positions have reasonable concerns. In my opinion, the idea is worth supporting when those difficulties are addressed.

paragraphs.label: Quan điểm thứ nhất
paragraphs.text: On the one hand, supporters focus on the benefits. One important point in favour of the proposal is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. This is possible because clear containers reduce the chance that paper and plastic become mixed with food waste. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: Quan điểm thứ hai
paragraphs.text: On the other hand, a more cautious view deserves attention. A difficulty that should not be ignored is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. This matters because extra effort feels pointless when separated bags are later mixed together. For instance, a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are different views about the proposal that communities should encourage practical water-saving habits. Supporters emphasise its usefulness, while others believe that practical difficulties should be dealt with before it is introduced more widely. Both positions have reasonable concerns. In my opinion, the idea is worth supporting when those difficulties are addressed.

paragraphs.label: Quan điểm thứ nhất
paragraphs.text: On the one hand, supporters focus on the benefits. One important point in favour of the proposal is that people can avoid wasting treated water. This is possible because noticing leaks and unnecessary running taps can reduce waste without removing essential uses. For example, a household can repair a dripping tap and use a bowl when washing a small amount of produce. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
